evidence.reason: The implementation substitutes both `%i` and `%I` with the same instance string extracted from the unit filename. systemd defines `%i` as the escaped instance name and `%I` as the unescaped instance name, so for a unit such as `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket`, `%I` should resolve to `crq-tick`, not `crq\x2dtick`. The current code therefore fails to match a referenced `Service=crq-tick.service` and can drop the intended dependency edge. Applying systemd unit-name unescaping only to `%I` while leaving `%i` unchanged is the smallest compatible correctness fix.
